outreach.improvementSummary: Removed the stacked cookie-consent + email-quiz popup blocking the PDP on load, moved price and the top benefit line above the style/quantity picker, backed the 5-star rating with a trust badge (was sitting next to just 2 reviews), added a return/guarantee line near the CTA, repositioned the chat bubble off the sticky Add to Cart zone, and swapped the hero image to remove a competing brand's product from frame.
outreach.pitchDraft: Hey — quick one. I put together an unofficial redesign concept for your NFC review-card product page. Right now a cookie modal and an email quiz stack on load, and the price + benefits sit below the style picker. I moved things around so a buyer sees why the product matters before they're asked to choose anything. Not asking for anything — just wanted to share since I think it'd move the needle. Want me to send the before/after and the 3 changes I'd prioritize first?
